issues.on_page: Other 102,160 = General 66,656 (p11: sales tax 34,225, expense reimbursements 8,838, interest on investments 2,225, sale of property 50, other 21,318) + Street 599 + Park 10,127 (pool receipts 3,525, other 6,602) + Library 3,094 + Cemetery miscellaneous 1,684 + Debt Service income for bonds 20,000
issues.issue: Printed row is 'Other', so kept as printed (same treatment as Harvard_FY2024). But the fund schedules print a breakdown that adds up exactly, and Taxes and Intergovernmental were split from those same schedules while Other was not. As a result the statement-level sales tax is 34,225 (Street only) although the schedules print 68,450 (General 34,225 + Street 34,225). Needs a person to decide whether to split.

issues.on_page: Charges for services: General 1,750, Park 1,360, Cemetery 6,650, Disposal Service 80,569
issues.issue: 80,569 of the line is disposal (refuse) fees, which the rules put in Utility Charges, as the detail line does (p25). The p6 fund columns add up exactly, so a split is possible. Kept as one printed row, consistent with FY2024.

issues.on_page: Capital outlay 1,730 (General Fund column; no function on the row)
issues.issue: The function comes from the p13 Police schedule, not from the p6 row, its heading or the fund column. The amount ties to Police equipment 1,730, so this is defensible.

issues.on_page: Public Works - other: Street Lights 19,487, Cemetery 21,987, ARPA 116,492
issues.issue: Mixed function line. The cemetery part is health/welfare in detail (p23), so the statement and detail levels disagree for 21,987.

issues.on_page: Operation and maintenance: Water 67,955, Sewer 14,101, Sanitation Fees 32,205
issues.issue: The line includes the sanitation system contract (32,205) and water utilities, insurance, contracted services, lab fees and sales tax (p29). 'Repairs and Maintenance' covers only part of it, so other/Operating could fit.
The printed label includes fines, so the 'Fines and Licenses' category may fit better.

Year tie: ending fund balance 676,245 = Harvard_FY2024 beginning_fund_balance 676,245, and business_type ending 216,545 = FY2024 business_type.beginning 216,545 (both tie as printed, no restatement). But Harvard_FY2024 beginning_investments is null while FY2023 prints ending investments 29,833. FY2024's p5 2023 comparative column should be checked. This is not an error in this file.
